pkgmetadata.longdescription: Argo CD is a declarative, GitOps-style continuous delivery tool for Kubernetes — application state lives in a git repo, and an in-cluster controller reconciles the live cluster against that desired state. This package ships the upstream argocd CLI binary (linux/amd64 and linux/arm64), which is the local client for talking to an Argo CD controller (over the API server, or directly to Kubernetes via --core mode). Source is available (Apache-2.0, Go) but a source build would require a multi-hundred-MB vendor tarball; the prebuilt binary upstream releases is statically linked and matches what every other distribution packages.
